booking.comment: Online booking is handled by Zocdoc. The provider-level link is the PRIMARY destination while Dr. Matthew Phillips is the only provider; the practice-level link is stored for future multi-provider support. To make the practice link the default site-wide later, change primaryScope to "practice" and point primaryBookingUrl at practiceBookingUrl — no template edits required. CTAs render via src/_includes/partials/booking-cta.njk. See README 'Booking (Zocdoc)'.

address.full: 2600 E Southern Ave, Suite B1, Tempe, AZ 85282

analytics.comment: Conversion events always push to window.dataLayer. Set endpoint to a same-origin path (e.g. /collect) to also beacon events to the first-party collector; leave empty to disable the beacon. Set ga4Id to a Google Analytics 4 Measurement ID (G-XXXXXXX) to load gtag.js and forward conversion events to GA4; leave empty to keep GA4 off. See docs/analytics.md.
